scope: Selected successor decisions touching Link, FreeText, and Line table cells, not whole ADRs.

decisions.reconsideration: The current region path uses QuadPoints when accepted and Rect on the table's fallback conditions. The exact-xref test checks both activation and pressed highlight in/out of region; a corpus census alone is not treated as the oracle.
decisions.disposition: Retain the tested source-driven fallback. No new test draft: escaping QuadPoints are already checked by link_quadpoints_audit.rs.

decisions.reconsideration: Read with EC3 #287, which sharpens the precedence to shall ignore Border when BS is present. Current test conflicts Border width/radii/dash and verifies the BS-only result. The table is not a malformed-input refusal rule.
decisions.disposition: Retain; no subtype-specific gap found in this pass.

decisions.topic: B/I relief styles for Link/FreeText borders
decisions.reconsideration: The general Table 168 style language and subtype-specific width/dash rows have a scope-reading issue. Current implementation behavior is documented and contrast-tested, but I do not elevate the broader-style reading into a confirmed ISO defect in this bounded audit.
decisions.disposition: Retain as qualified interpretation and rendering policy; avoid claiming each subtype row independently mandates every general style.

decisions.reconsideration: Table 177 explicitly places CL coordinates in default user space. ADR 0329 supersedes the earlier omission and tests the line outside the text rectangle. RD separately defines the text inset; it is not a CL clip rule.
decisions.disposition: Retain current CL route, with no new test because geometry, point count, intent gating, LE endpoint, RD independence, and outside-Rect behavior already have discriminating assertions.

decisions.reconsideration: Table 178 states caption text shall be replicated when Cap is true. The later ADR implements the caption and CP/CO placement. Current tests compare Cap absent/true, omitted CP default Inline versus Top, and a nonzero CO displacement.
decisions.disposition: Retain; no new test draft. Exact font, size, and some text layout choices remain local because the table does not prescribe them.

decisions.reconsideration: ADR 1784 preserves the required Line while naming unsupported ending values; EC3 #515 adds RClosedArrow to the fill set, with current tests checking its IC sensitivity. Tests are read by body, not names/comments alone.
decisions.disposition: Retain current bounded behavior; no repeated test needed.

decisions.topic: FreeText rich text and default style
decisions.reconsideration: These later decisions supersede early refusal/limited-style premises. Current variable-text and rich-text tests cover selected XFA 3.3 behavior and Contents/RC relationship; this audit does not certify all XFA syntax.
decisions.disposition: Retain current limited coverage with explicit residual; no new test.
